name: layout-grid
blurb: Masonry grid cards expand to center when clicked with dark overlay.
description: A responsive grid layout with click-to-expand functionality. Selected cards zoom to center with layout animation and dark backdrop, returning to grid when clicking outside.
use_when: Photo galleries, project portfolios, and case study showcases with click-to-view detail interaction.
avoid_when: Mobile-first designs; expanded cards center on viewport which may be off-screen on small devices.
a11y: Click handlers on motion.div; no keyboard navigation, focus management, or escape key handling.
